quests.name: A Dwarf and His Tools
quests.text: Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.

quests.name: A Sign of Hope
quests.text: Find Prospector Ryedol and let him know Hammertoe Grez is alive.

quests.name: A Sign of Hope
quests.text: Find Hammertoe Grez in Uldaman.

quests.name: Power Stones
quests.text: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

quests.name: Pearl Diving
quests.text: Bring 9 Blue Pearls to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.

quests.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
quests.text: Find 10 Small Stone Shards and bring them to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.

quests.name: Coolant Heads Prevail
quests.text: Find Frost Oil and bring it to Lotwil Veriatus in Badlands.

quests.name: Gyro... What?
quests.text: Bring a Gyrochronatom to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.

quests.name: Liquid Stone
quests.text: Bring a Healing Potion and a Lesser Invisibility Potion to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

quests.name: Agmond's Fate
quests.text: Bring 4 Carved Stone Urns to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Find Agmond
quests.text: Find Agmond.

quests.name: Mirages
quests.text: Retrieve the Supply Crate for Sigrun Ironhew.

quests.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
quests.text: Bring 3 Large Stone Slabs to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.

quests.name: Badlands Reagent Run
quests.text: Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and 5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, Badlands.

quests.name: Terror of the Desert Skies
quests.text: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: Terror of the Desert Skies
quests.text: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

quests.name: The Black Box
quests.text: Take the Corroded Black Box to the Hall of Arms in Ironforge.

quests.name: Solution to Doom
quests.text: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest
quests.text: Give the Sigil of the Hammer to Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.

quests.name: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest
quests.text: Bring the Sigil of the Hammer to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.

quests.name: Forbidden Knowledge
quests.text: Bring Yagyin's Digest to Theldurin.

quests.name: Coyote Thieves
quests.text: Bring 30 Coyote Jawbones to Neeka Bloodscar in Kargath.

quests.name: Report to Helgrum
quests.text: Bring Neeka's Report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.

quests.name: Barbecued Buzzard Wings
quests.text: Bring 4 Buzzard Wings to Rigglefuzz.

quests.name: Amulet of Secrets
quests.text: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.text: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.text: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

quests.name: Passing Word of a Threat
quests.text: Find Advisor Belgrum and give him his note.

quests.name: Passing Word of a Threat
quests.text: Speak to Historian Karnik.

quests.name: Scrounging
quests.text: Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.

quests.name: The Hidden Chamber
quests.text: Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: The Lost Dwarves
quests.text: Find Baelog in Uldaman.

quests.name: Safety Checks
quests.text: Recover 8 Unstudied Artifacts, an Explorers' League Mining Helmet, and a Pristine Mattock and bring them to Dorgaron at the border of Loch Modan and the Badlands.

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.text: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: The Shattered Necklace
quests.text: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.

quests.name: Lore for a Price
quests.text: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.text: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar. The necklace may be damaged.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.text: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

quests.name: Murdaloc
quests.text: Slay Agmond's killer, Murdaloc.  Slay 12 Stonevault Bonesnappers.  Report to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.

quests.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
quests.text: Bring 5 Bracers of Rock Binding to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.

quests.name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
quests.text: Bring some Patterned Bronze Bracers to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

quests.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
quests.text: Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.

quests.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
quests.text: Bring Cog #5 to Lotwil Veriatus.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.text: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Back to Uldaman
quests.text: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman. The slain paladin he mentioned was the person who had it last.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.text: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.text: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace. In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.

quests.name: Replacement Phial
quests.text: Bring a Mana Potion, Coal, and Sweet Nectar to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to get a replacement for Talvash's Phial of Scrying.

quests.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
quests.text: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Ghak Healtouch in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.text: Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.

quests.name: Reclaimed Treasures
quests.text: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.

quests.name: Find the Gems
quests.text: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman. Once acquired, contact Talvash del Kissel remotely by using the Phial of Scrying he previously gave you.  From the journal, you know... * The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area. * The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves.  * The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.

quests.name: Tremors of the Earth
quests.text: Retrieve the Sign of the Earth for Garek.

quests.name: Broken Alliances
quests.text: Kill Boss Tho'grun and bring the Sign of the Earth to Gorn in Kargath.

quests.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
quests.text: Return the items on the Bonegrip's Note to Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge.

quests.name: An Ambassador of Evil
quests.text: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: Restoring the Necklace
quests.text: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.text: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath. Jarkal believes a power source might be found on the strongest construct present in Uldaman.  From the journal, you know... * The ruby has been stashed in a barricaded Shadowforge area. * The topaz has been hidden in an urn in one of the Trogg areas, near some Alliance dwarves. * The sapphire has been claimed by Grimlok, the trogg leader.

quests.name: Deliver the Gems
quests.text: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Badlands Reagent Run II
quests.text: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the Badlands. Once you have them filled, bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
quests.text: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.

quests.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
quests.text: Defeat the Fam'retor Guardian and bring Lotwil's Shackles of Elemental Binding back to Lotwil Veriatus.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.text: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments
quests.text: Acquire a Black Drake's Heart for Sigrun Ironhew.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.text: Speak with stone watcher and learn what ancient lore it keeps. Once you have learned what lore it has to offer, activate the Discs of Norgannon.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.text: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the Explorers' League in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.text: Take the miniature version of the Discs of Norgannon to the one of the sages in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Tremors of the Earth
quests.text: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal, and Diamond and obtain the Runestones.  Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.  Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Garek.

quests.name: Broken Alliances
quests.text: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones.  Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus.  Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.

quests.name: Dreadmaul Rock
quests.text: Venture forth to the Burning Steppes and find out what became of Sha'ni Proudtusk.

quests.name: Disharmony of Flame
quests.text: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

quests.name: The Burning Beast
quests.text: Find an expert on the beasts of the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: The Rise of the Machines
quests.text: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus.  You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

quests.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
quests.text: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.  Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.  The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Frost Protection Potion
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
